The Little Library: 社区里的小小免费图书馆。
There is a small red box in front of Mrs Green's house. It looks like a bird house, but it is a little library.
People can take a book from the box and read it at home. When they finish, they put the book back. They can also leave their own books for others.
Every week, Mrs Green cleans the box and adds new books. Children in the street love it. They read a story there every afternoon after school.
